other_conditions: Must be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Must have a minimum of three years of regular membership before completing the age of 60 years
Must not be receiving pension benefits from any other Department/Board/Corporation of the Haryana Government
Must submit a life certificate every year in the month of November
Must attach a copy of the document submitted as proof of age
Must attach a No Objection Certificate issued by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits_summary: A registered construction worker receives a pension of ₹3,250 per month after turning 60 years of age.
documents_required: No Objection Certificate from the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
